bio.text: Raúl Torrez is New Mexico's Attorney General and is the Democratic candidate for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He first won the office in 2022, after serving as Bernalillo County's district attorney.
Earlier, he was a White House fellow under President Barack Obama and a prosecutor in the U.S. Attorney's Office; he began his career litigating child abuse cases.
